hypothesis.method: Neural Architecture Search using evolutionary meta-learning on transformer variational autoencoders
hypothesis.problem: Inability of current generative models to reliably produce interpretable, domain-specific latent representations for medical imaging synthesis
hypothesis.goal: Achieve human-interpretable, clinically meaningful latent space structure with zero-shot generation of rare pathological conditions

messages.content: Propose one novel and scientifically valid research hypothesis in the field of artificial intelligence, in particular generative AI. Express it as three short phrases: a Method (the technique to be used), a Problem (the problem to be addressed), and a Goal (the property to be improved). Answer only with a JSON object of the form {"method": "...", "problem": "...", "goal": "..."} and nothing else.
